## Context / Problem

Originally an evidence + proposal ticket for an additive-obligation parity criterion (P0-P3).
The operator rulings recorded in this ticket's comments (2026-08-21) narrowed the executable
scope, and this description now reflects only that approved scope:

- **P2 — APPROVED, no replay necessary:** widen plan-review overlay T13's trigger lexicon from
  *prohibition* to *obligation*. Operator expectation on record: the phrasing seems specific
  enough that it will provide minimal value — implement as the cheap prompt edit it is.
- **P1 — ASSESSMENT ONLY, no implementation:** measure whether the recommended
  content-triggered widening of `surface-parity` (plus the NDJSON/import channel) would have
  yielded historical false positives, before any adoption decision.
- **P0 (import-integrity) — DEFERRED:** pending separate operator confirmation of the
  deterministic CI import-walk alternative. Not touched here.
- **P3 (`project.obligation-parity` overlay) and ci-gate-compat — REJECTED:** not touched;
  the ci-gate-compat decline is being recorded in the gap-analysis doc under ticket 0778-b9c8.

The full original evidence (samples, base rates, prior art) is preserved verbatim in the first
comment on this ticket.

## Approach

**P2 (the code change).** T13's rubric body is the packaged prompt
`src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_T13.md` (trigger lexicon at lines 12-14 currently lists
prohibition verbs only: "block", "reject", "require … before", "enforce", "must pass",
"cannot merge until", "deny", "fail the build if"); its router applicability text is the
`"T13"` entry in `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_routing.json` (line 1108, trigger: "plan
NEWLY FORBIDS a previously-permitted action"). Widen both from prohibition-only to obligation:
the overlay also applies when the plan ADDS a new obligation — a contract, invariant, schema
field, required argument, or a second site that must stay in step — that existing sites now
owe. Keep the MIGRATED/EXEMPTED/UNCOVERED classification, the fail-open abstain rule, and the
advisory posture/threshold unchanged. The deterministic pre-gate in
`src/rebar/llm/plan_review/det_gate_rules.py` gains a second alternation branch carrying the
additive-obligation lexicon (per the Gerrit LLM-Review reachability finding on change 2035:
additive-only phrasings otherwise never reach the router); the audit-verbatim
enforcement branch (ticket 696a) stays byte-for-byte, and fires-side unit coverage is added. Regenerate
`docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md` with its generator
(`python -m rebar.llm.plan_review.registry regenerate-criteria-guide`, implemented at
`src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_guide.py:48`) — never hand-edit the guide.

**P1 (analysis, no code).** Enumerate historical commits in a recent window (target: the last
~60 days or ~40 qualifying commits, whichever bounds first) that changed CLI argument/guard
surfaces under `src/rebar/_cli/` — i.e. commits the widened content-triggered surface-parity
would have TRIGGERED on. For each, determine ground truth from the diff and surrounding
history: did the MCP or NDJSON/import surface genuinely owe a matching update, and was it
updated? Classify each would-be finding TP/FP, report the FP rate, and compare against the
~90%-`none` omitted-scope-site precedent already cited in this ticket. Judgment + git
evidence only — no paid LLM review replays. Record the result as a ticket comment prefixed
"P1 FP ASSESSMENT:" with trigger count, TP/FP split, and an adopt/narrow/reject
recommendation.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_T13.md` — widen title/trigger paragraph wording from
  prohibition-only to obligation
- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_routing.json` — the `"T13"` trigger text and checklist
  wording widened to match
- `docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md` — regenerated output only
- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/det_gate_rules.py` — additive-obligation alternation branch on
  the T13 pre-gate (review-driven; audit-verbatim branch unchanged)
- `tests/unit/plan_review/test_det_criterion_gates.py` — fires-side coverage for that branch

No other files change; P0/P3/ci-gate-compat artifacts are untouched.

## Testing

Prompt-content change with existing coverage: `tests/unit/test_plan_review_evals.py`
(`test_g5_prohibition`) asserts the MIGRATED/EXEMPTED/UNCOVERED enums remain in the prompt and
the T13 eval cases stay wired; `tests/unit/plan_review/test_det_criterion_gates.py` covers the
untouched deterministic pre-gate; the guide-parity validation
(`src/rebar/llm/plan_review/guide_parity.py`) fails if the regenerated guide diverges from the
registry. Run those targeted tests plus `make lint` and `make typecheck`. Default: no new
tests — the edit adds no new runtime behavior (assume this unless an existing test fails).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] T13's rubric applies to newly ADDED obligations, not only prohibitions; checked by
      `grep -c obligation src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_T13.md` returning >= 1 and the
      trigger paragraph naming additive obligation examples.
- [ ] The routing entry matches the widened applicability; checked by `rebar explain T13`
      showing the obligation wording.
- [ ] `docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md` is generator output; checked by re-running the
      generator and `git diff --exit-code docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md` passing.
- [ ] Targeted tests, `make lint`, and `make typecheck` pass in the worktree venv.
- [ ] The P2 commit carries the `rebar-ticket: 5bca-4ca9-3dc8-4abd` trailer and is pushed to
      Gerrit `refs/for/main`; checked by the Gerrit change existing with both gate votes
      requested (landing is gated on `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`).
- [ ] A "P1 FP ASSESSMENT:" comment is recorded on this ticket with trigger count, TP/FP
      split, FP rate vs the ~90%-`none` precedent, and a recommendation; checked by
      `rebar show 5bca-4ca9`.
- [ ] The diff touches only the three Scope paths (P0 deferred, P3/ci-gate-compat rejected);
      checked by `git show --stat` on the P2 commit.

## Verification

`make lint`, `make typecheck`, targeted pytest above, generator idempotence check, and the two
Gerrit gate votes on the pushed change. The ticket stays `in_progress` after this slice — P0's
disposition is pending with the operator, so no close this session.
